# log10p1_breaks_like

## Description

Breaks and label generator for log10p1_trans

```r
log10p1_breaks_like(x)
```

## Arguments

- `x`: the numeric vector for which labels are computed

## Returns

A numeric vector of breaks (powers of 10, preceded by 0 if `x` contains values below 1).

## Examples

```r
log10p1_breaks_like(c(0, 5, 2000))
log10p1_breaks_like(c(3, 50, 800))

library(ggplot2)
df <- data.frame(x = 1:5, y = c(0, 3, 30, 300, 3000))
ggplot(df, aes(x, y)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_y_continuous(trans = log10p1_trans, breaks = log10p1_breaks_like)
```
